CREATE TABLE EDS.GENERATIONAL_COHORT_DIM(
    GENERATIONAL_COHORT_ID	int
    ,VERSION_NUM	int
    ,VERSION_NAME	varchar(80)
    ,LOW_LIMIT	int
    ,HIGH_LIMIT	int
    ,GENERATION_BRACKET	varchar(80)
    ,SOURCE_CODE	varchar(20)
    ,INSERT_DTTM	datetime
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
    HEAP
)



CREATE TABLE [D360].[STG_EDS_DID_GENERATIONAL_COHORT_DIM]
( 
	[H] varchar(50),
    GENERATIONAL_COHORT_ID	int,
    VERSION_NUM	int,
    VERSION_NAME	varchar(80),
    LOW_LIMIT	int,
    HIGH_LIMIT	int,
    GENERATION_BRACKET	varchar(80),
    SOURCE_CODE	varchar(20),
	[FILE_NAME] [VARCHAR](100),
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)


ALTER TABLE EDS.GENERATIONAL_COHORT_DIM
ADD FILE_NAME VARCHAR(100)
